excerpts.text:
You can now animate any of your component, HTML or SVG elements using `v-motion`.

```vue
<template>
  <div
    v-motion
    :initial="{
      opacity: 0,
      y: 100,
    }"
    :enter="{
      opacity: 1,
      y: 0,
    }"
  />
</template>
```

To see more about how to use directives, check out [Directive Usage](https://motion.vueuse.org/features/directive-usage).
